Filtering Regions to London
```{python}
# 1. Load the shapefile (point to the .shp; the .shx, .dbf, and .prj must sit beside it)
rgn = gpd.read_file(DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "Regions_December_2025_Boundaries_EN_BFE_4960550324708213025" / "RGN_DEC_2025_EN_BFE.shp")

# Look at the attribute columns so you know what to filter on
print(rgn.head())
print(gdf.columns)

# 2. Filter down to the one polygon you want, e.g. by an attribute value
ldn = rgn[rgn["RGN25NM"] == "London"]
print(ldn.crs)

# 3. Save as GeoParquet
ldn.to_parquet(DATA_DIRECTORY / "processed" / "spatial-boundaries" / "regions" / "rgn_2025_bfe_london.parquet")
```

Filtering Output Areas 2011 to London
```{python}
# 1. Load the shapefile (point to the .shp; the .shx, .dbf, and .prj must sit beside it)
oa_2011 = gpd.read_file(DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "Output_Area_2011_EW_BFE_V2" / "OA_2011_EW_BFE_V2.shp")

# Look at the attribute columns so you know what to filter on
print(oa_2011.columns)
print(oa_2011.crs)

# 2. Filter down to the one polygon you want, e.g. by an attribute value
oa_2011_london = oa_2011[oa_2011["LAD11CD"].str.startswith("E09")].copy()
print(oa_2011_london["LAD11CD"].nunique())  # should be 33
print(len(oa_2011_london))                  # should be 25,053

# 3. Keep only the output area code (plus geometry)
oa_2011_london = oa_2011_london[["OA11CD", "geometry"]]

# 4. Save as GeoParquet
oa_2011_london.to_parquet(DATA_DIRECTORY / "processed" / "spatial-boundaries" / "output-areas" / "oa_2011_bfe_london.parquet")
```

Filtering Output Areas 2021 to London
```{python}
# 1. Load the shapefile (point to the .shp; the .shx, .dbf, and .prj must sit beside it)
oa_2021 = gpd.read_file(DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "OA_2021_EW_BFE_V9" / "OA_2021_EW_BFE_V9.shp")

# Look at the attribute columns so you know what to filter on
print(oa_2021.columns)
print(oa_2021.crs)

# 2. Filter down to the one polygon you want, e.g. by an attribute value
london_lads = {
    "Barking and Dagenham", "Barnet", "Bexley", "Brent", "Bromley", "Camden",
    "City of London", "Croydon", "Ealing", "Enfield", "Greenwich", "Hackney",
    "Hammersmith and Fulham", "Haringey", "Harrow", "Havering", "Hillingdon",
    "Hounslow", "Islington", "Kensington and Chelsea", "Kingston upon Thames",
    "Lambeth", "Lewisham", "Merton", "Newham", "Redbridge",
    "Richmond upon Thames", "Southwark", "Sutton", "Tower Hamlets",
    "Waltham Forest", "Wandsworth", "Westminster",
}

lad_name = oa_2021["LSOA21NM"].str.replace(r"\s\d{3}[A-Z]$", "", regex=True)
mask = lad_name.isin(london_lads)
oa_2021_london = oa_2021[mask].copy()

print(lad_name[mask].nunique())  # should be 33
print(len(oa_2021_london))       # roughly 26,000

# 3. Keep only the output area code (plus geometry)
oa_2021_london = oa_2021_london[["OA21CD", "geometry"]]

# 4. Save as GeoParquet
oa_2021_london.to_parquet(DATA_DIRECTORY / "processed" / "spatial-boundaries" / "output-areas" / "oa_2021_bfe_london.parquet")
```




National Statistics UPRN Lookup (June 2026) (Epoch 127) meets AddressBase

```{python}
# NSUL
cols = ["UPRN", "OA21CD", "LSOA21CD", "MSOA21CD", "WD25CD", "PCON24CD", "LAD25CD", "RGN25CD"]
nsul_2026 = pd.read_csv(
    DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "national-statistics-uprn-lookup" / "NSUL_E127_JUN_2026" / "Data" / "NSUL_E127_JUN_2026_LN.csv",
    usecols=cols,
    dtype={c: str for c in cols} | {"UPRN": "Int64"},
)
nsul_2026["OA21CD"].isna().sum() # 0 NA

# AddressBase
addressbase_by_year = step_load_addressbase_by_year([2011, 2021, 2026])
addressbase_by_year = step_harmonise_addressbase(addressbase_by_year)
addressbase_by_year = step_add_is_residential(addressbase_by_year)
ab_2011 = addressbase_by_year[2011]
ab_2021 = addressbase_by_year[2021]
ab_2026 = addressbase_by_year[2026]

# NSUL x AddressBase 2026
ab_2026_nsul_2026 = pd.merge(
    ab_2026, nsul_2026, how='left', left_on='uprn', right_on='UPRN'
)

ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched = ab_2026_nsul_2026[ab_2026_nsul_2026["OA21CD"].isna()]
# 412 NA

ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("is_residential_space")
# 100 residential spaces

len(ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("local_custodian_code"))
# 19 different authorities

plt.scatter(ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched["x_coordinate"], ab_2026_nsul_2026_unmatched["y_coordinate"], s=1)
plt.gca().set_aspect("equal")
plt.show()
# all around the edges = it works!!!


# NSUL x AddressBase 2021
ab_2021_nsul_2026 = pd.merge(
    ab_2021, nsul_2026, how='left', left_on='uprn', right_on='UPRN'
)

ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched = ab_2021_nsul_2026[ab_2021_nsul_2026["OA21CD"].isna()]
# 21408 NA

ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("is_residential_space")
# 741 residential spaces

len(ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("local_custodian_code"))
# 34 different authorities

plt.scatter(ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched["x_coordinate"], ab_2021_nsul_2026_unmatched["y_coordinate"], s=1)
plt.gca().set_aspect("equal")
plt.show()
# everywhere = need 2021 file!!!


# NSUL x AddressBase 2011
ab_2011_nsul_2026 = pd.merge(
    ab_2011, nsul_2026, how='left', left_on='uprn', right_on='UPRN'
)

ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched = ab_2011_nsul_2026[ab_2011_nsul_2026["OA21CD"].isna()]
# 56293 NA

ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("is_residential_space")
# 25297 residential spaces

len(ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched[ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched["OA21CD"].isna()].value_counts("local_custodian_code"))
# 35 different authorities

plt.scatter(ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched["x_coordinate"], ab_2011_nsul_2026_unmatched["y_coordinate"], s=1)
plt.gca().set_aspect("equal")
plt.show()
# everywhere = need 2021 file!!!

```
